paragraphs.text: Pontotoc residents who want help comparing Medicare prescription drug plans have five weekdays left on the local counseling schedule after Thanksgiving. Three Rivers offers free help at 75 S. Main St. in Pontotoc. Its county listing gives 662-489-2415 as the number to call before making the trip.

The posted hours are 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday. That leaves Nov. 30 and Dec. 1, 2 and 3, followed by one final Monday, Dec. 7. Bring your Medicare card and a list of the prescription drugs you take. Three Rivers says its counselors have no affiliation with an insurance company.

The medication list can help answer a practical question about next year’s coverage. Medicare’s comparison tool uses the prescriptions you enter to estimate what each plan would cost you by the month and by the year. Medicare recommends including every prescription you take regularly to get the most accurate estimate.

Anyone who decides to change plans during open enrollment must get the request to the plan by Dec. 7 for the new coverage to start Jan. 1, 2027. The South Main Street office lists 4:30 p.m. as the end of its counseling day on that final Monday.
